Skilled in excep- tion monitoring, investigation and resolution of operational breaks, data validation, reconciliation, root cause analysis and control reporting. Experienced in analysing trade data, investigating dis- crepancies, managing workflow exceptions and coordinating with Operations, Technology, Trading, Sales, Documentation teams, custodians and external stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of operational issues. Strong understanding of financial products, post-trade processes, operational controls, reporting and risk management frameworks.
